descriptionChirho: The city or valley of Jezreel (יִזְרְעֶאל), a prominent location in the territory of Issachar, associated with Ahab's palace, Naboth's vineyard, and Jehu's revolt, as well as a town in Judah (Joshua 15:56); all prepositional and directional variations refer to the same geographic referent.

Jezreel as a masculine proper name, referring either to a descendant of Etam in the genealogy of Judah (1 Chronicles 4:3) or to the symbolic name given to Hosea's firstborn son signifying 'God sows' (Hosea 1:4).
